evals.name: revit_logs_analysis
evals.prompt: Run agent-ci on the Revit Drafter logs directory at '~/.agents/logs/sample'. Extract all failure telemetry and generate a Continuous Improvement report in the current workspace under agent-ci-reports/.
evals.expected_output: A markdown report in agent-ci-reports/ with executive summary, top bottlenecks, looping detection, and hardening recommendations.
expectations: A valid telemetry JSON is generated with nodes and edges
A Markdown report is created in agent-ci-reports/
The report includes Executive Health Summary with Healthy, Warning, and Failed percentages
The report identifies tool thrashing / loops (e.g. repeated revit:execute_revit_code calls)
The report provides actionable hardening recommendations

evals.name: multi_source_and_clean_logs
evals.prompt: Analyze a session log directory containing mixed CLI and Chat-Agentic sessions with 100% clean executions (no errors, no loops). Verify that agent-ci correctly classifies sources and reports a 100% healthy status.
evals.expected_output: A markdown report showing 100% healthy status with accurate source breakdown and zero critical bottlenecks.
expectations: Correctly distinguishes CLI and Chat-Agentic source distributions
Health summary reports 100% Healthy sessions and 0% Failures
Reports 'No excessive looping or tool thrashing patterns detected'
Recommendations suggest maintaining healthy baseline without false alarms

evals.name: fatal_crashes_and_user_corrections
evals.prompt: Analyze session logs that contain Level A fatal timeouts/crashes and Level C user prompt corrections (e.g., 'salah, ulangi'). Verify that agent-ci flags these high-severity failures and provides targeted rule recommendations.
evals.expected_output: A markdown report showing high failure rate, detailing Level A crashes and Level C correction signals.
expectations: Flags the overall workspace as high friction / failure required
Recommends Scope Alignment (Grill-Me Gate) based on user correction detection
